mapper.sql: P.PRGRM_INTRD_SN, P.PRGRM_CTGRY_CD, P.PRGRM_TTL, P.PRGRM_EXPLN, P.PLC_CN, P.OPRTN_PD_CN, P.NOPE_CN, P.APLY_URL_ADDR, P.IMG_FILE_ID, P.SORT_SEQ, P.USE_YN, P.DEL_YN, P.REG_DT, P.RGTR_NM, P.MDFCN_DT, P.MDFR_NM, P.DEL_DT, P.DLTR_NM, ( SELECT C.CD_DTL_NM FROM CMMN_CD_DTL C WHERE C.CD_ID = 'COM048' AND C.CD_DTL_ID = P.PRGRM_CTGRY_CD ) AS PRGRM_CTGRY_NM, ( SELECT F.ATCH_FILE_PATH_NM FROM ATCH_FILE_INFO F WHERE F.ATCH_FILE_MNG_NO = P.IMG_FILE_ID ORDER BY F.FILE_SEQ DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS FILE_URL, ( SELECT F.ORGNL_FILE_NM FROM ATCH_FILE_INFO F WHERE F.ATCH_FILE_MNG_NO = P.IMG_FILE_ID ORDER BY F.FILE_SEQ DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS FILE_NAME
mapper.select: SELECT FROM EDU_PRGRM_INTRD P WHERE P.PRGRM_INTRD_SN = #{value} AND P.DEL_YN = 'N'
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(SORT_SEQ), 0) + 10 FROM EDU_PRGRM_INTRD WHERE DEL_YN = 'N'
SELECT CD_DTL_ID AS code, CD_DTL_NM AS name FROM CMMN_CD_DTL WHERE CD_ID = 'COM048' AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY SORT_SEQ ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE EDU_PRGRM_INTRD SET PRGRM_CTGRY_CD = #{prgrmCtgryCd}, PRGRM_TTL = #{prgrmTtl}, PRGRM_EXPLN = #{prgrmExpln}, PLC_CN = #{plcCn}, OPRTN_PD_CN = #{oprtnPdCn}, NOPE_CN = #{nopeCn}, APLY_URL_ADDR = #{aplyUrlAddr}, IMG_FILE_ID = #{imgFileId}, USE_YN = #{useYn}, MDFCN_DT = NOW(), MDFR_NM = #{mdtr} WHERE PRGRM_INTRD_SN = #{prgrmIntrdSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
